assumptions: Operators retain harm policy, manual review, contestability, and final intervention authority; the product operates in audit mode until effectiveness and governance are demonstrated.
No platform access, operator commitment, cross-operator data right, causal performance advantage, or regulator acceptance is assumed.
The pricing, sales cycle, security cost, specialist cost, margins, and thirty-operator scale are unvalidated planning assumptions.
Behavioral risk labels are purpose-limited to player protection and technically and contractually unavailable for promotional targeting.

factors.name: Core insight
factors.rationale: Binding identify-act-evaluate duties create a real gap between detecting risk and proving that protective interventions work. The audit-first framing is responsible, but the insight is no longer distinctive because an installed specialist has announced intervention-selection and outcome-evaluation capability closely matching the thesis.

factors.name: Customer pain and willingness to pay
factors.rationale: Material enforcement penalties and continuing operator accountability establish high compliance and reputational pain. Willingness to buy this separate product remains unknown because operators can procure incumbent responsible-gambling suites, develop rules internally, or obtain controls through their platform vendor.

factors.name: Business model and economics
factors.rationale: Operator subscriptions can be valuable and recurring, but the planning case assumes thirty enterprise customers and high blended revenue without observed pricing or sales cycles. Platform share, security review, privacy and regulatory counsel, specialist governance, insurance, model monitoring, support, and long procurement can consume both margin and the stated initial capital before repeatable acquisition is proven.

factors.name: Market and beachhead
factors.rationale: The GB remote gambling economy is large, and mid-sized operators outside incumbent outcome products form a logically bounded segment. The evidence does not quantify how many such operators are reachable, unlocked, and willing to adopt a new high-risk vendor, while broader EU expansion is fragmented rather than supported by one harmonized procurement duty.

factors.name: Competitive position and domination potential
factors.rationale: Mindway AI has installed detection distribution and is building the same intervention and evaluation layer, while EveryMatrix already bundles responsible-gambling controls. A new part-time entrant has no demonstrated data access, regulatory reputation, platform leverage, or performance edge with which to dominate even the proposed beachhead.

factors.name: Expansion potential
factors.rationale: Success in one platform could extend to additional operators, interventions, and jurisdictions. Each expansion adds jurisdiction-specific rules, privacy analysis, data normalization, security review, and specialist governance, while the EU recommendation does not create a uniform market, making adjacency materially costly.

factors.name: Defensibility and durability
factors.rationale: Purpose-limited response labels and longitudinal outcomes could eventually improve selection and create switching costs. Lawful pooling and comparable outcome definitions are unresolved, operators and platforms control the source data, and installed incumbents are better positioned to accumulate the same evidence sooner.

factors.name: Strength of advantage
factors.rationale: Regulator-ready auditability and strict separation from promotion are necessary trust features but not yet a demonstrated performance advantage. The supplied randomized pilot found no clear intervention benefit over active control, and no evidence shows this proposed system improves harm outcomes, compliance cost, or operator economics relative to existing approaches.

factors.name: Timing and momentum
factors.rationale: Active UK enforcement and explicit ongoing evaluation obligations create demand pressure for better evidence and audit trails. At the same time, privacy guidance is changing and incumbents are already moving into outcome evaluation, so urgency benefits established vendors as much as or more than a new entrant.

factors.name: Distribution
factors.rationale: One player-account or CRM integration could theoretically reach multiple operators. No platform has shown willingness to provide access or distribute the product, the platform can build or bundle the feature, and direct regulated-enterprise sales would be long, relationship-intensive, and poorly matched to the founder's preferred operating model.

factors.name: Execution and risks
factors.rationale: Behavioral analytics suits the founder technically, but credible delivery requires responsible-gambling expertise, privacy counsel, security assurance, causal evaluation, operator integration, regulatory-grade documentation, and careful human review. The combination of high stakes, enterprise procurement, liability, part-time availability, and limited capital makes execution materially difficult.

main_structural_strength: A binding and recurring operator duty to evaluate customer interactions creates a high-stakes workflow with recurring budget potential and measurable post-intervention outcomes.
primary_score_limiter: The entrant lacks both privileged distribution and demonstrated causal advantage in a category where installed platform and specialist vendors already control operator access, data, and closely overlapping functionality.
strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Mindway AI already has an operator-scale detection product and announced an intervention-selection and outcome-evaluation capability closely overlapping this thesis; separately, a 2026 randomized pilot found no clear intervention advantage over active control.
evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A paid audit-mode deployment secured through a platform and operator should establish lawful outcome rights, acceptable security and governance cost, specialist and regulator acceptance, measurable causal improvement over active operator controls, a credible procurement cycle, positive contribution payback, and renewal intent.
highest_value_structural_change: Reposition from a general intervention-orchestration API to an independent regulator-ready experimentation and assurance layer that evaluates operator and incumbent interventions without replacing them, with pre-registered protocols and specialist sign-off; this reduces direct feature competition and makes neutrality the product advantage.
